2609.17181.title: Multimodal Cultural Heritage Architectural Style Classification for Residential Buildings in the UAE Based on CLIP Embeddings and SVM
2609.17181.paper_summary: The analysis and classification of cultural heritage architectural styles remain challenging due to the complexity of visual images of buildings, which are highly relied on in traditional CNN-based classification approaches in comparison to textual descriptions, and the relative lack of non-western region-specific datasets. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a multimodal machine learning framework to analyze and classify Emirati residential architecture using OpenAI's CLIP model. We integrate visual features from images and textual features from expert descriptions into a unified 512-dimensional embedding, followed by dimensionality reduction with UMAP for visualization and unsupervised clustering using K-Means. Cluster labels, which are derived from manual analysis of the K-Means clusters, are used to train an SVM classifier for automated architectural style classification. Our approach achieves a classification accuracy of 98% across eight identified style clusters, higher than every other study in the literature, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining visual and textual modalities. Overall, this paper highlights the potential of using multimodal AI to support architectural heritage analysis, offering scalable and interpretable tools for exploring regional architectural identities.
2609.17181.paper_summary_zh: 文化遺產建築風格的分析與分類仍然面臨挑戰，因為建築的視覺圖像複雜，這在傳統的基於CNN的分類方法中高度依賴，而與文本描述相比，非西方地區特定數據集相對缺乏。本文通過提出一個多模態機器學習框架，來分析和分類阿聯酋住宅建築，填補了這一空白，該框架使用OpenAI的CLIP模型。我們將來自圖像的視覺特徵和來自專家描述的文本特徵整合成一個統一的512維嵌入，然後使用UMAP進行降維以便於可視化，並使用K-Means進行無監督聚類。從K-Means聚類的手動分析中得出的聚類標籤用於訓練SVM分類器，以實現自動化的建築風格分類。我們的方法在八個識別的風格聚類中達到了98%的分類準確率，這比文獻中的其他研究更高，顯示了結合視覺和文本模態的有效性。總的來說，本文突顯了使用多模態人工智慧支持建築遺產分析的潛力，提供了可擴展和可解釋的工具，以探索地區建築身份。
